title: feat(evals): also write each run's results outside the checkout (#195)
body:
## Summary Every live eval run that finishes (`--replay` included) now writes its `.json`/`.md` pair to `--out` as before, then a second copy to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/serverless-ai-scheduling/eval-results//` (`~/.local/state/…` when `XDG_STATE_HOME` isn't absolute), so removing the worktree that ran it keeps the results (incident 2 on #72). `EVAL_RESULTS_COPY_DIR` replaces the directory; a copy directory (the per-checkout subdirectory the files go to) inside the repository is a usage error, the directory is created before the first model call, and a failed copy write only warns. The logic, including the `--dry-run` gate and the copy-failure warning, is in a new tested module, `packages/evals/src/results-copy.ts`; `cli.ts` only wires it. The real file calls are one adapter in `cli-args.ts`, shared with the calibration step. No flag was added. - `packages/evals/src/index.ts`: one `export * from "./results-copy";` line and a header bullet for the new module (r1/A-4, E-2). - `packages/evals/src/cli.ts` header and its `v8 ignore` reason updated for the second location (AC 5, A-4). - `packages/evals/src/cli-args.ts`: `fileCalibrationDeps`'s file writer now goes through a new exported adapter, `nodeFileWrites` (`FileWrites`), which `results-copy.ts` also uses (d43a881/SMELL-1); calibration's behaviour is unchanged. ## Decisions the spec left open Listed once, each with the alternative it beat, in the journal entry's "Why we chose what we chose": [docs/journal/2026-10-06-eval-results-outlive-the-worktree.md](docs/journal/2026-10-06-eval-results-outlive-the-worktree.md).
